nom: Clarins Hydrating Gentle Foaming Face Cleanser

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found it still worked well for makeup removal, though a separate reviewer warns the cleanser may not feel deep-cleansing enough for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the cleanser leaves skin clean and hydrated without tightness or stripping, including one who bought it for her husband's dry skin with good results.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report improved pores, more even complexion, and no new irritation, with one calling it exactly what her combination skin had needed.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers describe it as gentle and non-irritating with no tightness, but one long-time user says a recent reformulation made her sensitive skin reactive and another found it stripped and left a film.
segments.normal: The product is explicitly marketed and used for normal to dry skin, with reviewers in this group reporting clean, non-drying results.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s report smoother, brighter, hydrated skin, though one mature-skin reviewer specifically notes it left her skin tight and dry.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 50s report smoother, brighter-looking skin and improved firmness when paired with other Clarins products; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry and sensitive skin, report the cleanser hydrates without leaving skin tight or stripped; one reviewer with dry skin says it did not help much and one reformulation complaint describes skin left stripped and filmy.
concerns.redness: Sensitive-skin reviewers frequently report no irritation or redness from this cleanser; one reformulation-related review reports new reactivity.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers state their natural barrier felt intact and not stripped after use; one dissenting review describes skin left with a tight, dry feeling and another describes a film with stripped skin after the reformulation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with a seborrheic patch and hormonal acne reports improvement and no flare-ups; another reviewer says the cleanser made her break out.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer prone to occasional acne reports no new breakouts after a month of use; another reports the product caused her to break out.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the cleanser is recommended for normal to dry skin and may not feel deep-cleansing enough for oily skin, though a different oily-skin reviewer found it worked well for removing makeup.

aspects.libelle: Tube packaging hard to empty fully

extraits.texte: I have been using Clarins gentle cleanser for at least 15 years. In recent years, they have been reformulating their cleanser. This most recent formulation made my sensitive skin very reactive. They have so many cleansers. Why mess with the cleanser for people with sensitive skin? When I reached out to return it, they only would let me return the one cleanser still in the box. I did not even get a refund for the second full tube. Do better Clarins. Nothing good to say about this experience.

Loved the former formula, it left you feeling clean and hydrated - never had issues. The new formula is absolutely awful and so different. I'm so frustrated that it changed so much. Leaves your skin feeling squeaky and like a film on it but also stripped. Do not recommend. Hoping the old formula comes back so I can stop having to find a new cleanser.
I love all products from Clarins, but this face wash made me break out

extraits.titre: a lovely addition to my daily routine
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I use this cleanser for just a few days because it was a small sample. The creamy texture turns into light silty foam that feels gentle on the skin. I didn't feel any dryness or harsh. Tugging. Has someone in my '50s would skin that leans on the dry side, I appreciate how it leaves my face feeling clean, soft and hydrated and never tight. I've noticed my skin looks smoother and a bit brighter. It also rinses easily which is a big plus. If you have mature or sensitive skin and want to cleanser that feels luxurious yet effective, this is worth trying.

extraits.titre: Fairly good cleanser. A bit drying for mature skin
extraits.texte: The Clarins hydrating foaming cleanser is a nice gentle cleanser for sensitive skin. It is only lightly foaming, while cleansing well. My only complaint was that it left my skin in particular with a tight/dry feeling. And it needs to be rinsed well. I also received the cryo mask for free. That, I did not feel met my expectations. It left my skin feeling dry and tight. Definitely not glowing. I received the Clarins Hydrating Gentle Foaming Cleanser for free from #Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

This us hands down one if the best fave washes ive used. Picked it up randomly and thank god i did. I have combination skin, hormonal acne, and seborroic patch on my chin that tends to flare up. I've noticed an imporovement on my pores, my complexion looks more even and brighter, and it does not cause any irritation on my chin either. Would recommend

This face wash will now be a staple of mine. I have dry, sensitive skin and despite the somewhat strong luxurious scent, it did not bother my skin at all. A little goes a long way so you get good value for what you pay for. It lathers on evenly and washes off completely without stripping your skin and making it feel dry. I have been using this for about a month now and I've seen a noticeable difference in the evenness in my skin and my pores are smaller. I use this with the clarins serum and I have no issues using that serum after I wash my face with this. I'm very happy with this purchase
